🚨 The La Liga Pichichi RETURNS to action tomorrow against Real Betis. How many do you think he'll score tomorrow? 👀⚽

Raphinha is still leading the Pichichi favorite charts with a 49% chance, per Polymarket. 💥
Off to Seville ✈️

🚨🎙️| Marc Bartra (Real Betis): "How La Masia is different? The first is the feeling of BELONGING. It's a philosophy of football and a LOVE for the club that you develop from a young age. And the second is how it's done. You learn in a very important way, focusing on technique, tactics, and understanding the game." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Marc Bartra (Real Betis): "Raphinha? Right now he seems UNSTOPPABLE. He's in a really hot spot, an incredible moment. You might be able to stop him for one play, but the next he'll easily get past you, cutting inside, shooting quickly. He's one of the most UNPREDICTABLE players right now." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Marc Bartra (Real Betis): "Cubarsí for the Golden Boy award? I would give it to him. He EARNED it, especially considering how he conducts himself on the field tactically, technically, and in terms of character, especially at his age. There are some very good players, but being a STARTER for Barça and the Spanish national team makes him the clear favorite, in my opinion." #fcblive
